versions.content: Definition of a custom trigger for an extended data record It is possible to define a custom trigger for the capturing of an extended data record. The custom nature, however, severely limits the possibilities for a formal description of such a trigger. Therefore, AUTOSAR can only provide a means to verbally describe how the custom trigger shall operate. For this purpose the attribute DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord . customTrigger has been defined.
